q: HSE certifications [OSHA (General Industry + Relevant HSE Trainings
r: Participate in management meetings with the site management to keep them updated on HSE matters
Participate in the investigations for HSE incidents
Implement the Hazard Reporting, Action Tracking Register and Scorecard for the site.
Implement HSE Management Systems and procedures on site.
Prepare Risk Assessments and recommend corrective actions.
Conduct routine inspections related to (scaffolding / electrical / cranes etc.)
Inspect the fire fighting and protection equipment in the plant
Ensure positive relation with the clients’ HSE team.
Resolve any complaints from the client related to HSE issues.
